content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_OF_LEASE
content_blocks.text: This Lease Agreement shall commence on October 20, 2024, and continue for a period of twelve months.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the premises known as Unit 3B, located at 789 Maple Street, Springfield City, State of Novamont.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._RENT
content_blocks.text: The Tenant agrees to pay rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, payable on the first day of each month.
